summary: The root هلك (hlk) primarily means to perish or be destroyed. It can also describe a gradual perishing due to grief.
lane: 6 تَهَالَكَ غَمًّا ذ [app. He perished gradually by reason of grief. ] (A, art. سوس : see 1 in that art.) -b2- تَهَالَكَ عَلَيْهِ He was vehemently eager for it. (TA.) -b3- تَهَالَكَ فِيهِ He strove, laboured, toiled, or exerted himself, in it, namely in running; as also . (TA.) He strove, laboured, toiled, or exerted himself, and hastened, in it, namely an affair; as also استهلك . (TA.) -b4- تَهَالَكَتْ said of a she-camel, i. q. عَشِقَتْ [ She vehemently desired the stallion ]. (AA, TA in art. عشق .)
